company.title: ProStack360
company.subtitle: Software Developer – Frontend
company.headline: Building a metadata-driven enterprise CRM capable of generating complete business systems from configuration.

roles.title: Lead Frontend Architecture & UI Systems
roles.description: Spearheaded the development and architectural design of the platform's core functional modules, focusing on scalability, performance, and highly customizable user experiences.
impact: Achieved a ~30% reduction in application load times through optimized state management and lazy-loading techniques.
Drove a ~25% measurable improvement in team collaboration and workflow speed by centralizing tools.
Successfully established highly reusable, modular UI systems that accelerated the delivery of future features.
engineering_insights: Building real-time WebSocket systems necessitates a 'failure-first' mentality to ensure data integrity during disconnects.
Modular, component-driven UI systems scale exponentially better and are easier to maintain than traditional page-level designs.
Strategic state architecture and data-flow management often have a deeper impact on perceived application performance than rendering optimizations alone.

projects.project_context: ProStack360 is a comprehensive, modular CRM platform engineered to streamline workflow automation, form management, real-time collaboration, and cross-team analytics.

architecture.high_level: Frontend (React / Next.js / TypeScript) ➔ REST APIs & WebSockets ➔ Backend (PHP)
architecture.infrastructure: Cloud Infrastructure: AWS S3, EC2, CloudFront CDN
architecture.design_paradigm: Modular frontend architecture paired with event-driven, real-time communication.
architecture.asset_delivery: CDN-backed static and media delivery for optimal performance.

key_features.title: Dynamic Module Builder
key_features.problem: Users required complete autonomy to customize and construct bespoke CRM modules tailored to their specific business operations.
key_features.solution: Architected a dynamic, schema-driven Module Builder that automatically generates complex Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) UIs based on user-defined configurations.
technical_details: Engineered support for over 28 distinct field types (including complex data like formulas, multi-user lookups, and linked records).
Developed deeply nested, row-based subforms equipped with automated arithmetic computations for tax, discounts, and quote generation.
Built specialized module UI views, including Gantt charts for Project management, integrated Zoom/Google Meet connections for Meetings, and IMAP-synced custom mail views for Emails.
Implemented intelligent CRM automations, including lead conversion mapping, automated quote/invoice generation, and dynamic autofill pipelines.
key_features.outcome: Delivered a fully modular, zero-code environment that empowers users to generate sophisticated workflows and financial documents directly within the CRM.

key_features.title: Advanced Email Editor
key_features.problem: Users needed a robust, native email authoring experience (similar to Gmail) featuring drafts, templates, and rich previews without leaving the platform.
key_features.solution: Built a high-performance, modular email editor utilizing Tiptap, seamlessly integrated with the platform's IMAP functionalities.
technical_details: Designed custom Tiptap extensions for rich text formatting and complex schema validation.
Implemented an auto-draft recovery system using LocalStorage alongside asynchronous API saves to prevent data loss.
key_features.outcome: Accelerated user email creation workflows while virtually eliminating data loss during unexpected application crashes or network drops.

key_features.title: WebForm Builder
key_features.problem: Non-technical users lacked an intuitive method to design dynamic web forms and data-capture layouts.
key_features.solution: Developed a fluid, drag-and-drop form builder using dnd-kit and react-grid-layout.
technical_details: Created a component-driven form schema integrated with a responsive grid-based layout system.
Linked form submission flows directly to custom CRM modules, ensuring seamless, automated data ingestion upon submission.

key_features.title: Analytics Dashboard
key_features.problem: Clients needed a customizable interface to visualize deal pipelines, module summaries, and real-time business metrics.
key_features.solution: Constructed a drag-and-drop dashboard builder utilizing robust grid layouts and dynamic charting engines.
technical_details: Built mechanisms to translate raw module data into interactive analytics graphs (e.g., deal pipeline funnel charts).
Engineered a flexible, grid-based layout system allowing users to resize and arrange real-time data widgets.

key_features.title: Interactive Calendar Integration
key_features.problem: Users needed a unified interface to track and manage upcoming meetings, calls, and integrated events.
key_features.solution: Integrated and customized react-big-calendar to sync bi-directionally with users' primary calendars.
technical_details: Engineered the UI to allow instantaneous creation of meeting, call, or event records directly from the calendar interface.
Synchronized external user data to provide a reliable, single source of truth for scheduling.

key_features.title: High-Performance Table View
key_features.problem: The platform struggled to fluidly render datasets exceeding 100 columns and infinite rows.
key_features.solution: Rebuilt the data-table architecture using pagination-based lazy loading, optimized for a frictionless user experience.
technical_details: Implemented WebSockets for real-time row updates with strict role-based access control.
Added support for custom user views, complex multi-column sorting/filtering, and bulk operations (update, delete, email).
key_features.outcome: Provided a highly responsive, simplified navigation experience for massive, complex datasets.

key_features.title: Automated Timesheets
key_features.problem: Management required precise logging of employee active hours based on actual system interaction rather than manual entry.
key_features.solution: Developed an intelligent background tracking service that monitors UI engagement to calculate active working time down to the exact second.
technical_details: Captured granular system activity through optimized keyboard, mouse, and UI interaction event listeners.
Utilized WebSockets to broadcast live status updates across the administration dashboard in real time.
